description: This file defines custom PySide6 widgets for editing durations, including a widget for hours, minutes, seconds, milliseconds, and a switchable format between HH:MM:SS:MS and seconds. It includes classes for handling user input, updating time values, and emitting signals when the duration changes.

classes.name: Widget_hhmmss
classes.description: A widget for editing durations in hours, minutes, seconds, and milliseconds with sign toggle.

classes.name: Widget_seconds
classes.description: A widget for editing duration in seconds with decimal precision.

classes.name: Duration_widget
classes.description: A composite widget that allows switching between HH:MM:SS:MS and seconds formats for duration input.

methods.name: change_sign
methods.description: Toggle the sign (+/-) of the duration.

methods.name: update_time_value
methods.description: Calculate total duration in seconds based on widget inputs and emit signal.

methods.name: value_changed
methods.description: Handle changes in individual spin boxes, reset values if out of bounds, and update prefix.

methods.name: time_changed
methods.description: Emit signal when the duration value changes.

methods.name: set_time
methods.description: Set widget display based on a duration in seconds.

methods.name: set_format_s
methods.description: Switch widget to seconds display format.

methods.name: set_format_hhmmss
methods.description: Switch widget to HH:MM:SS:MS display format.

methods.name: set_format
methods.description: Set display format based on provided format constant.

methods.name: get_time
methods.description: Return current duration in seconds as a Decimal.
